graph.name: Recall promises about a topic
graph.description:
Recall stored promise episodes with a saved topic query, then render optional next-reply guidance.

Lesson: Capture the actor’s evidenced promise, then recall saved Query “ferry”. Commitment is not proof of fulfillment.

Limitations: The zero-call query is saved configuration and does not trigger itself from each turn. Use Reflect Recall at Pre 1 for present-context appraisal; dynamic trigger binding is future work.

Opening installs an unassigned copy. Bind local model roles and provide the documented evidence before running.

Pre: at most 0 auxiliary calls. Preview before publishing or applying.

Try changing:
Change Query to “harbor”; compare matched IDs. Recall has no per-turn input.
Inspect fulfillment evidence with Capture to here before a full Run.

Documentation specimen (does not seed chat or actor memory):

Stored promise: Sol promised to meet Mira at the ferry before dawn.

Configured ferry recall: Return the stored promise in a bounded brief. Treat it as a commitment, not proof that Sol has arrived.

Fixed-query callback: No inputs/trigger; saved Query runs every Pre run. Reflect Recall + Context/Episodes is the one-Analysis alternative.

Capture the commitment: Analysis ≤1, unbound. To here never writes; full Post Run writes local memory without review. Save may be unconfirmed.

No seeded state: Fixtures only; opening seeds nothing. Pre Recall/Compose/Guidance: zero calls.

Ferry promise episodes (pre-recall)
Purpose: Recall actor’s fixed topic.
Fixture: Fixture: a captured episode says “Sol promised to meet Mira at the ferry before dawn.”
Inspect: Check episodes/classifications/refs; empty store is valid.

Promise is still a commitment (pre-compose)
Purpose: Render episodes as advisory Guidance.
Inspect: Check full /payload/episodes array, including [].

Ferry callback brief (pre-output)
Purpose: Expose the callback brief.
Inspect: Check relevance to the present scene.
